Local original PMC article-version objects including PDFs, XML, figures and supplemental files; original item rights remain distinct from collection and require review before public staging.
Local original sequence-source records; retain original provenance and review record-level terms before public staging.
Local Europe PMC supplemental packages with item-level rights pending; retain package locally and publish provenance metadata only.
Local supplemental research files; item-level redistribution rights remain unreviewed. Publish retrieval metadata, URLs and hashes only.
Local synonym and higher-taxon literature discovery includes unreviewed article rights; publish metadata, URLs and hashes until rights are reconciled.
Local candidate full-text excerpts; same article-level rights review as their original XML required before public staging.
Local candidate full texts; index open-access labels do not verify article-level redistribution rights. Reconcile each actual license before public staging.
Full published paper; redistribution rights unverified. Retain locally and publish its DOI, hash and own factual synthesis.
Derived full paper text; inherits the original paper redistribution boundary.
Transient public landing-page capture contains session form state; no biological claims depend on publishing it.
Local source-page inspection image; original paper redistribution rights remain unverified.
Local source collection with unreviewed article-level rights; publish metadata, source URLs and hashes only until rights are reconciled.
